tagline: Embed Loom videos into Notion pages automatically and create docs from video transcripts
metaTitle: Notion + Loom Integration: A Searchable Video Knowledge Base
metaDescription: Embed Loom recordings in Notion pages by topic and turn transcripts into docs. GAIA builds a searchable video library. See the setup steps.
intro:
Loom videos capture knowledge in a way that written documentation can't—a product walkthrough, a design critique, a process explanation—but video content is notoriously hard to search and organize. Recordings pile up without being linked to the relevant Notion pages where they would provide the most context. Knowledge shared in a video gets lost when someone new joins the team because no one connected it to the written documentation.

GAIA bridges the two so that video and written knowledge reinforce each other. When a Loom is recorded and shared with GAIA, it is automatically embedded in the relevant page based on the video's title and content. GAIA can also extract the transcript and generate a structured document from it, making video knowledge searchable and scannable.

For teams that rely heavily on async video communication, this integration transforms a scattered library of recordings into a structured, searchable knowledge base anchored in Notion, ensuring that important knowledge shared in video format is never lost.

useCases.title: Auto-embed Loom recordings in Notion pages by topic
useCases.description: When a video is recorded and tagged with a project name or topic, GAIA finds the relevant Notion page and embeds it in a dedicated Recordings section, keeping video content organized with its written context.

useCases.title: Generate docs from Loom transcripts
useCases.description: GAIA extracts the auto-generated Loom transcript, structures it into a page with headings, bullet points, and action items, making the video's content searchable and scannable for those who prefer reading over watching.

useCases.title: Create Notion action item pages from meeting videos
useCases.description: When a video is recorded as a meeting update or project review, GAIA identifies the action items mentioned in the transcript and creates a task page with the items listed, assignees suggested, and the original video embedded.

useCases.title: Build a searchable onboarding video library
useCases.description: GAIA automatically catalogs recordings tagged as onboarding content into a dedicated database with title, description, speaker, duration, and a direct embed, creating a self-updating new hire resource library.

useCases.title: Link design walkthroughs to specs
useCases.description: When a designer records a walkthrough of a new design, GAIA links the video to the corresponding spec page and adds a summary of the walkthrough as a page comment, keeping design decisions documented alongside specs.

howItWorks.step: Connect Notion and Loom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize your Notion workspace and Loom account in GAIA's integration settings. Specify which databases should receive embedded videos and transcripts.

howItWorks.step: Configure video routing and transcript rules
howItWorks.description: Define how videos are matched to pages — by video title, tags, or workspace folder — and configure whether GAIA should embed the video, generate a transcript document, extract action items, or all three.

howItWorks.step: GAIA builds your video knowledge base automatically
howItWorks.description: When a video is recorded and processed, GAIA routes it to the appropriate pages and generates any configured documents. Your knowledge base grows automatically as your team continues to record.

faqs.question: Does GAIA embed Loom videos directly in pages or just link to them?
faqs.answer: GAIA uses the embed block to insert videos directly into pages so they can be watched without leaving the page. The video appears as an inline playable embed rather than an external link.

faqs.question: How accurate are the auto-generated transcripts for GAIA to work with?
faqs.answer: The transcripts are generally accurate for clear speech but may need light editing for technical terms or heavy accents. GAIA's transcript-to-page feature works well for structured content and clearly stated action items.

faqs.question: Can GAIA handle a large backlog of existing videos?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can run an initial batch import of your existing library, creating pages or database entries for each video. You can filter which videos to import by date range, workspace folder, or creator.

faqs.question: What if I record a video that belongs to multiple Notion pages?
faqs.answer: GAIA can embed the same video in multiple pages if the video's tags or content match multiple pages. You can also manually specify multiple destination pages when sharing the video via GAIA.
